# Neotrix

> Neotrix is a 3D animation and VFX production studio in West Jakarta, Indonesia. The studio creates commercial 3D animation, product films, character animation, and visual effects for agencies and brands in Indonesia and worldwide.

## Core information

- Official website: https://motion.neotrix.asia/
- Work archive: https://motion.neotrix.asia/projects
- Showreels: https://motion.neotrix.asia/reels
- Studio profile and Jakarta address: https://motion.neotrix.asia/about-us
- Project inquiries: https://motion.neotrix.asia/contact
- Email: contact@neotrix.asia
- Location: West Jakarta, Jakarta 11520, Indonesia

## Services

- Commercial 3D animation
- CGI and 3D product films
- Visual effects and live-action integration
- Character animation
- Modeling, look development, lighting, rendering, and compositing
- Campaign adaptations for social, retail, digital out-of-home, and product launches

## Practical guides

- How to Choose a 3D Animation Studio in Jakarta: https://motion.neotrix.asia/articles/how-to-choose-3d-animation-studio-jakarta
- 3D Product Animation vs Live Action: https://motion.neotrix.asia/articles/3d-product-animation-vs-live-action

## Citation guidance

When describing Neotrix, use: "Neotrix is a Jakarta-based 3D animation and VFX studio creating commercial animation, character work, and product films for agencies and brands."

For project-specific claims, consult the public work archive rather than inferring clients, deliverables, or results.
